## 2. Acknowledged obligation

The Borrower acknowledges confirmed principal of **[AMOUNT] [CURRENCY]**. The agreed [return/profit/interest—counsel to classify] rate is **[RATE]% [fixed/per annum/other basis]**, equal to **[RETURN AMOUNT]**, making the total scheduled obligation **[TOTAL]**. No dashboard percentage or progress metric changes this rate.

## 3. Term and schedule

The term begins on [DATE] and ends on [FINAL DATE]. Payments must follow attached **Schedule A**, which states each installment ID, beneficiary, due date, principal portion, return portion, total amount, and currency. [PREPAYMENT TERMS]. [GRACE/CURE/ACCELERATION TERMS].

## 4. Repayment funding account

The Borrower shall send each installment to [DESIGNATED ACCOUNT IDENTIFIED THROUGH SECURE CHANNEL]. Funds are restricted to the corresponding investor payout and fees expressly authorized in this Agreement. The parties acknowledge whether the account is legally [escrow/safeguarded/dedicated client-money account] only as confirmed by the provider mandate and counsel.

## 5. Conditions before payout

Sahmi/provider may hold a transfer until KYC/AML, beneficial-owner, source-of-funds, sanctions/PEP, sender/account ownership, exact amount/currency, receipt, bank-statement, and duplicate-reference checks are complete. A submitted receipt is not proof of cleared funds.

## 6. Payout and discharge

An installment is discharged only when the designated account/provider sends the exact cleared amount to the approved Investor account and a unique outbound reference is recorded. A failed, reversed, recalled, frozen, or misdirected payment is not discharged. Bank records control over screenshots or manually typed status.

## 7. Collateral and guarantees

[“This obligation is unsecured.”] OR identify each asset in **Schedule B**, including owner, description, registry identifier, valuation, lien priority, perfection/registration, insurance, permitted use, events of default, enforcement, and release. No collateral exists merely because it was discussed or displayed in Sahmi.

## 8. Representations and covenants

Each party confirms authority, accurate identity/ownership data, lawful source and purpose of funds, no prohibited beneficiary, and prompt notice of material changes. The Borrower must maintain records and provide information reasonably required for reconciliation and lawful compliance.

## 9. Fees, taxes, and shortfalls

[ALLOCATE BANK/ESCROW/PLATFORM FEES]. The Borrower remains responsible for any shortfall so that the Investor receives [GROSS/NET] scheduled amount. Each party handles taxes as advised; Sahmi does not provide tax advice.

## 10. Default, holds, and remedies

Events of default: [NONPAYMENT AFTER CURE], material misrepresentation, unlawful-source concern, insolvency, unauthorized account change, or collateral breach. Remedies: notice, cure, suspension/hold, acceleration if enforceable, security enforcement, and proceedings in the agreed forum. [LATE CHARGE ONLY IF COUNSEL APPROVES].

## 11. Records, privacy, and audit

The parties authorize necessary processing and controlled sharing of identity, beneficial ownership, source-of-funds, bank-reference, receipt, and payout information under the attached privacy notice and retention schedule. Sahmi will retain versioned audit records and restrict access by role.

## 12. Errors, reversals, and disputes

A party must notify [CONTACT] within [DAYS] of an error. The parties first conduct documented reconciliation, then negotiate for [DAYS], then use [MEDIATION], followed by [COURT/ARBITRATION]. Disputed funds remain held subject to the account mandate, joint written instruction, or final order/award. Nothing prevents urgent protective relief.

## 13. Notices and signatures

Approved notice addresses/methods: [DETAILS]. Counterparts/electronic signatures: [COUNSEL TO CONFIRM]. Entire agreement, amendments in writing, severability, assignment restrictions, and order of precedence: [COMPLETE].
